successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""99.9% uptime SLA" (trust-signal badge)"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No SLA agreement exists. The app is hosted on Lovable/Supabase with no contractual uptime commitment. Any NJTA procurement officer will ask for the SLA document.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""API access is available for enterprise integrations — SiteManager, AASHTOWare, or interna"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No public or private API exists. There is no API surface in the codebase (no `/api` routes, no documented endpoints, no API key management). Telling prospects "contact us to discuss" implies imminent

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: "Workflow step 1: "Drop the PDF plan set from ProjectWise or your file system" — implies Pr"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: "ProjectWise Integration" is explicitly listed in the Roadmap section (`Landing.tsx:180`) as a future feature. Current support is file-system upload only.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Start Free Trial" CTA button navigates to `/auth`"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No free trial offering exists. The FAQ states pricing is per-project by quote only (`Landing.tsx:228`). The button label creates a false expectation; users reach a generic auth screen with no trial fr

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Dedicated onboarding for NJTA teams" trust-signal badge"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No onboarding materials, playbooks, dedicated CSM role, or onboarding SLA exist in the codebase or documentation. This is aspirational.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""30+ days — Payment delays from quantity disputes" stat"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Presented as industry fact with no citation, source study, or qualifying language. If a customer asks for the reference, none can be provided.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""5–15% variance — DC form errors compound monthly" stat"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Same issue as M-4: stated as fact, no citation or methodology.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Real-time sync across all inspectors" (comparison table)"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Sync is outbox-based (IndexedDB queue → Supabase on reconnect). Supabase Realtime is subscribed in some hooks (`useProject`, `useOutbox`) for cache invalidation, but inspectors do **not** see each oth

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: "Capability section: "Roll up all measurements into a pay item summary report that mirrors "
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Roadmap item (`Landing.tsx:181`) says "Automated Monthly Estimate Generation — Format quantities into NJDOT DC-84 payment estimate format" is future work. `export-utils.ts` produces generic XLSX expor

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""SOC 2 compliance roadmap" listed as a trust signal badge (present tense)"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: The phrase is a roadmap claim formatted as a present-tense trust badge alongside "Your data stays yours" and "99.9% uptime SLA". Prospects may read it as current compliance status.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: "Browser mockup address bar shows `app.takeoffpro.com`"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: The actual app lives at `draw-quantify-dash.lovable.app`. The domain `app.takeoffpro.com` does not exist (no DNS, no redirect).

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Zero Install" badge + FAQ: "No app install, no plugins, no VPN""
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: A native iOS/Android app is in active development (`capacitor.config.ts`, `STORE_LISTING.md`). The zero-install claim is accurate for the web version but creates a contradiction with the store listing

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Your data stays yours" trust-signal badge"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Data is stored in Supabase (a third-party SaaS). Customers cannot self-host or export their full database. The claim is emotionally accurate but technically ambiguous.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""99.9% uptime SLA" (trust-signal badge)"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No SLA agreement exists. The app is hosted on Lovable/Supabase with no contractual uptime commitment. Any NJTA procurement officer will ask for the SLA document.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""API access is available for enterprise integrations — SiteManager, AASHTOWare, or interna"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No public or private API exists. There is no API surface in the codebase (no `/api` routes, no documented endpoints, no API key management). Telling prospects "contact us to discuss" implies imminent

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: "Workflow step 1: "Drop the PDF plan set from ProjectWise or your file system" — implies Pr"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: "ProjectWise Integration" is explicitly listed in the Roadmap section (`Landing.tsx:180`) as a future feature. Current support is file-system upload only.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Start Free Trial" CTA button navigates to `/auth`"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No free trial offering exists. The FAQ states pricing is per-project by quote only (`Landing.tsx:228`). The button label creates a false expectation; users reach a generic auth screen with no trial fr

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Dedicated onboarding for NJTA teams" trust-signal badge"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: No onboarding materials, playbooks, dedicated CSM role, or onboarding SLA exist in the codebase or documentation. This is aspirational.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""30+ days — Payment delays from quantity disputes" stat"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Presented as industry fact with no citation, source study, or qualifying language. If a customer asks for the reference, none can be provided.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""5–15% variance — DC form errors compound monthly" stat"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Same issue as M-4: stated as fact, no citation or methodology.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""Real-time sync across all inspectors" (comparison table)"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Sync is outbox-based (IndexedDB queue → Supabase on reconnect). Supabase Realtime is subscribed in some hooks (`useProject`, `useOutbox`) for cache invalidation, but inspectors do **not** see each oth

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: "Capability section: "Roll up all measurements into a pay item summary report that mirrors "
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: Roadmap item (`Landing.tsx:181`) says "Automated Monthly Estimate Generation — Format quantities into NJDOT DC-84 payment estimate format" is future work. `export-utils.ts` produces generic XLSX expor

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: ""SOC 2 compliance roadmap" listed as a trust signal badge (present tense)"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: The phrase is a roadmap claim formatted as a present-tense trust badge alongside "Your data stays yours" and "99.9% uptime SLA". Prospects may read it as current compliance status.

successorsImplied.description: Resolve lie-tax: "Browser mockup address bar shows `app.takeoffpro.com`"
successorsImplied.whyNeeded: The actual app lives at `draw-quantify-dash.lovable.app`. The domain `app.takeoffpro.com` does not exist (no DNS, no redirect).
